description_en: Lists the user groups associated with device registration policies in your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下设备注册策略相关用户组
name: ListUserGroupsForRegistrationPolicy

parameters.help_en: A collection of device registration policy IDs. You can specify up to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 设备注册策略ID集合。最多可输入100个设备注册策略ID
parameters.name: policy_ids

Policies.description_en: A list of device registration policies

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the device registration policy

UserGroups.description_en: A collection of user groups associated with the device registration policy
UserGroups.description_zh: 设备注册策略的用户组集合

items.description_en: A user group associated with the device registration policy
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略的用户组

Attributes.description_en: A collection of user group attributes

IdpId.description_en: The identity provider ID for the user group. This field appears only when UserGroupType is department
IdpId.description_zh: 用户组的身份源ID。当自定义用户组类型为department时，存在该值

Relation.description_en:
The relation for the user group. Valid values:

Equal: Equal to.

Unequal: Not equal to
Relation.description_zh:
用户组的关系。取值：
Equal：等于。
Unequal：不等于

UserGroupType.description_en:
The type of the user group. Valid values:

username: A username.

department: A department.

email: An email address.

telephone: A phone number
UserGroupType.description_zh:
用户组的类型。取值：
username：用户名。
department：部门。
email：邮箱。
telephone：手机

Value.description_en:
The value of the user group attribute.

If UserGroupType is username, this is the username. It must be 1–128 characters long and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

If UserGroupType is department, this is the department name. Example: OU=Department 1,OU=SASE DingTalk.

If UserGroupType is email, this is the email address. Example: username\@example.com.

If UserGroupType is telephone, this is the phone number. Example: 13900001234
Value.description_zh:
用户组属性的值。
当用户组类型为username时，表示用户名的值。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
当用户组类型为department时，表示部门的值。如：OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉。
当用户组类型为email时，表示邮箱的值。如：username@example.com。
当用户组类型为telephone时，表示手机的值。如：13900001234

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the user group was created

Description.description_en: A description of the user group
Description.example: 这是一条被设备注册策略引用的用户组。

Name.description_en: The name of the user group

UserGroupId.description_en: The ID of the user group
